metadata.case_name: LAM KWAI YIP v. YUEN YUN KUI

plaintiff.occupation_before: Full-time dim-sum maker (restaurant) and part-time employee at fruit stall

injuries.description: 4 cm parietal laceration which required suturing
source: He sustained a 4 cm parietal laceration which had to be sutured.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Fracture of the calcis (heel bone) of the right foot
source: His right foot was swollen with a fracture in the calcis.
The fracture was treated with plaster.

According to the report of Dr. H.P. So of Orthopaedic Unit, Caritas Medical Centre, by 4.8.1993, the fracture to the right calcis had healed and the range of movement of the right ankle was nearly full.
Dr. Brian Choa, in his medical report dated 29.10.1994, observed that the fractured ankle will be a long term problem and there is the possibility of developing accelerated arthritis.

manifestations.description: he still felt pain in his right leg
he could not walk for more than 45 minutes
He had to walk with the aid of crutches for several months.
even after he could walk without crutches, he had to remain indoor
he had occasional headache and dizziness
the fractured ankle will be a long term problem and there is the possibility of developing accelerated arthritis

treatments_received: Admission to Caritas Medical Centre Surgical Unit and Orthopaedic Ward
Follow-up treatment at the Orthopaedic Outpatient Clinic of Caritas Medical Centre until November 1993
Chinese bone-setter treatment for about 6 months
Use of crutches for several months
Physiotherapy (follow-up & physiotherapy treatment listed in special damages)

losses.description: Could not walk for more than 45 minutes; had to walk with the aid of crutches for several months; had to rest after walking and remained indoors
Will not be able to manage two jobs; unable to return to previous profession or to perform work which requires him to stand for long hours

comparable_cases.case_name: Tsang Chin Keung v. Lo Tat Kong t/a Hung Kwong Glass Works & Anor.
comparable_cases.injury_description: The injuries suffered by the plaintiff in Tsang Chin Keung case are far more serious than those sustained by the Plaintiff in the present case.
